issue.title: [A+] In QA column hygiene — approved change set only
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Part of **A+ Process / CI** and Product signal. Project 4 **In QA** contains many **closed** fluent-mobile issues still sitting in the column, plus cross-repo noise — the column is a pile, not a FIFO queue.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Stale closed cards in In QA obscure real open QA work (#147, #188, #267, #269, #279, etc.).

**Expected:** Approved, **named** change set moves closed cards to **Passed QA** / **Done** (as appropriate). No silent board sweeps.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Publish proposed issue-number list in this ticket
- Get explicit tech-lead / Product approval on the named set
- Execute only the approved set

**Out of scope**
- Editing `In Progress (Product)` or other Product-owned columns without named approval
- Reopening closed feature work

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Comment on this issue lists every issue number to move + target Status
- [x] Written approval from tech lead (or named delegate) on that list
- [x] Approved moves completed; open In QA is only open Needs-QA work (**fluent-mobile**: #147, #188, #269)
- [x] No unapproved Status edits (web/api In QA cards left alone)

## Verification / test plan

1. Snapshot In QA before/after (view 9)
2. Diff against approved list

## Links

- `docs/guides/project-board.md` (hard rules)
- Board: https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9
- Execution: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/378#issuecomment-5413503446
